title: LinkedIn Post Generator
tagline: AI-powered content engine that writes viral LinkedIn posts in your voice
description: An intelligent content generation system that analyzes your writing style, industry trends, and engagement patterns to produce LinkedIn posts that sound authentically you. Built with LangChain, OpenAI GPT-4, and a custom fine-tuning pipeline.
problem: Content creators and professionals struggle to maintain consistent LinkedIn presence. Writing engaging posts takes 30-60 minutes each, leading to burnout and inconsistent posting. Existing AI tools produce generic, robotic content that damages personal brand credibility.
solution: A multi-stage AI pipeline that: 1) Ingests user's historical posts to learn voice/style, 2) Monitors industry trends via RSS/API, 3) Generates post ideas with viral potential scoring, 4) Drafts posts in user's voice with editable variants, 5) Predicts engagement before publishing, 6) Schedules optimal posting times.
architecture: Event-driven microservices on Vercel/Edge: Ingestion Service (webhooks + scheduled jobs) → Voice Profile Builder (embeddings + fine-tuning) → Trend Monitor (RSS + Twitter API) → Idea Generator (GPT-4 + RAG) → Post Drafter (few-shot + style transfer) → Engagement Predictor (regression model) → Scheduler (cron + timezone aware). Data: PostgreSQL + Redis + Pinecone for vectors.

lessonsLearned: Voice cloning requires 50+ samples for authenticity; fewer creates uncanny valley effect
Engagement prediction models need domain-specific training; generic models fail on niche topics
Edge functions cold starts add 200-500ms latency; warming strategies critical for UX
